title: Adjacency ledger — one-off cross-functional coverage snapshot
content:
Purpose: quick, disposable ledger to capture who can cover which rapid one-off operational/launch tasks across functions for the next 72 hours. Built after yesterday's all-hands where we identified multiple adjacency gaps during the canary rollout.

Context / constraints:
- Not a replacement for runbooks; this is for short-lived coverage only (3 days max) where multiple teams need a fast handoff map.
- Keep entries minimal: owner, role, slack contact, known blockers, confidence (H/M/L).
- We will triage nightly and escalate any remaining L gaps to the on-call lead.

Snapshot summary (as of 2028-06-13 09:30 PT):
- Total routes/tasks identified: 18
- Covered (conf >= M): 12 (67%)
- At-risk (conf = L): 4 (22%)
- Unassigned: 2 (11%)

Ledger rows (compact, informal):
Route / Task | Primary owner (role) | Backfill / adjacency | Slack | Blockers | Confidence
1) Hosted API - token throttles | Priya A (product-ops) | Liam O (eng-sre) | @priya | none | H
2) Region failover smoke (eu->us) | Kenji W (infra) | Sofia M (platform) | @kenji | short test creds | M
3) Dedicated pool autoscale alert | Sofia M (platform) | TBD | @sofia | must confirm quota bump | L
4) Private deploy audit logs ingestion | Carlos M (security) | Priya A | @carlos | KMS rotation in progress | L
5) Console rollout dashboard drift | Liam O (sre) | Kenji W | @liam | missing tracing hook | M
6) Billing anomaly investigate | Maya Patel (finance) | Priya A | @maya | incomplete invoice data | M
7) Embeddings batch job spike | Xuan Li (applied-ml) | Kenji W | @xuan | model pinned to v2 quant | H
8) Canary chat latency regression | Priya A | Xuan Li | @priya | p99 jitter in eu region | M
9) Model variant fallback test | Kenji W | TBD | @kenji | no canary config for v3 | L
10) Customer escalations (acct 8892) | Samira H (cs) | Priya A | @samira | legal loop | H
11) KV cache eviction burst | Liam O | Kenji W | @liam | spike correlates w/ batching policy change | M
12) Route-level quota enforcement | TBD | Sofia M | n/a | need policy owner | L
13) Platform release smoke (agent) | Kenji W | Liam O | @kenji | staging infra flaky | M
14) Observability alerts flood | Sofia M | Xuan Li | @sofia | retention job running | H
15) Private deploy ingress cert | Carlos M | TBD | @carlos | cert vendor delay | L
16) Docs rollout (user guides) | Priya A | Samira H | @priya | content review pending | M
17) Rollout playbook dry run | Liam O | Priya A | @liam | attendees limited | M
18) Edge routing smoke | TBD | Kenji W | n/a | needs runbook | L

Quick analysis notes:
- Three clear adjacency gaps where owners are "TBD" (rows 3, 9/12/15/18 — actually five). Prioritize filling the dedicated pool autoscale alert (row 3) and route-level quota enforcement (row 12) before midday to avoid weekend carryover.
- Confidence skew: most infra/serving-runtime items have M/H confidence; policy, billing, and private-deploy items skew L due to external dependencies (KMS, vendor certs, quota approvals).
- Suggested short plays:
  * 30-min cross-team sync at 11:00 PT to assign TBDs and confirm escalation contacts. Owner: Priya A to run.
  * Quick runbook stub for Edge routing (row 18) — Kenji to sketch in 2 hours.
  * Apply temporary fallback policy for model variant canary (row 9) — engineering to patch (Kenji + Xuan).

Open questions / unresolved:
- Who owns the quota policy for route-level enforcement? (possible owners: platform-security or product-ops).
- How to accelerate KMS rotation verification for private deploy customers without full vendor PKI — legal/security input needed.
- Can we repurpose a dedicated on-call alias to cover rows marked L for the next 48 hours?

Next actions (owners + ETA):
- Assign dedicated pool autoscale alert backfill: Sofia M to confirm by 2028-06-13 11:30 PT.
- Fill route-level quota owner: Priya A to loop in product-policy by EOD 2028-06-13.
- Edge routing runbook stub: Kenji W by 2028-06-13 12:30 PT.
- Temporary cert workaround for private ingress: Carlos M to propose vendor escalation ticket 2028-06-13 13:00 PT.
- Nightly triage cadence: brief update 20:00 PT (15 minutes) — leads: Priya A, Kenji W, Sofia M.

Notes to self: keep this ledger lean. If a route stays in L for >48 hours, move to longer-running tracker and open a follow-on Jira. Use the Confluence page linked above for runbook links and persistent artifacts.

Revision history:
- 2028-06-12 initial capture during post-rollout retro (Priya A)
- 2028-06-13 added confidence column and preliminary owners after cross-team DM sync
